name: @skein-code/cli
description: A context-first, model-agnostic coding agent with an auditable terminal workspace.

releaseNotes: The lockup's flight goose is replaced by the skein coil: a wound ring of thread whose loose end unspools toward the block wordmark, matching the geometric letterforms and echoing the winding spinner's resting ring form; layout, colour ramp, and accessibility fallbacks are unchanged

The startup identity is now a fused flight lockup: the Skein Goose climbs ahead of the block SKEIN wordmark, towing it by the ⌁ context thread, with a per-row theme colour ramp on the letters and the solid accent on the animal, in both the preparation screen and the persistent session banner; ASCII, narrow, constrained-height, and screen-reader terminals keep the deterministic text wordmark

Workspace preparation results persist as banner receipts (index size and chunks, build duration, workspace, model route, trust posture) instead of vanishing when the loading surface clears, and every model interaction settles into a quiet turn receipt carrying the model, duration, and separated input/output token flow

Live runs show weaving-metaphor phase words (Gathering threads, Spinning, Weaving the reply) beside a run clock, streaming token counters, and an esc hint; the footer gains a dim session token total on wide terminals, and the one-cell winding-thread spinner is now the single motion glyph across preparation, tool rows, the activity line, and the footer

The transcript now reads from a single left edge: every row shares one two-column status gutter, replacing the competing prompt, indent, and tool-tree edges, and tool calls become a width-derived aligned column that stays one row on narrow terminals instead of expanding to two

A tool that simply succeeded is silent: only running, failed, and cancelled calls claim a status glyph, and the redundant per-run tool group header is gone, so one real failure no longer carries the same visual weight as four successes

Terminal colour is now a single-meaning contract: accent marks only live or interactive elements, success only terminal completion evidence, warning only decisions and degradation, error only failure, and code literals get their own neutral tone instead of borrowing the success and warning colours for syntax highlighting
The composer rule drops its Request, Steer, Shell, and Editor labels for one neutral boundary, and the footer no longer repeats the mode and route already shown on the identity row

Transcript row estimates now word-wrap exactly like Ink instead of dividing width by columns, so virtualized PageUp/PageDown scroll anchors no longer drift on wrapped paragraphs, and a one- or two-row viewport can no longer push the composer off screen

The interactive workspace now uses Ink with @inkjs/ui for a production hierarchy across status, conversation, grouped tools, and a compact composer, with restrained dark, light, monochrome, ASCII, dumb-terminal, and screen-reader themes

Ctrl+O and /transcript toggle every tool detail together, while loading, success, error, cancelled, disabled, queued, approval, and streaming states retain consistent keyboard focus and truthful cancellation semantics

Routine zero-hit context events and per-turn model-input estimates stay out of the conversation timeline; detailed model-input and context-window accounting remains available through /context and structured headless output
Responsive terminal verification covers 20, 24, 40, 80, and 120 columns, 40x10, real PTY input, terminal UI latency budgets, Markdown, code highlighting, resize behavior, and Ctrl+C safe exit

Assistant replies drop the repeated brand nameplate, fenced code and quotes gain a quiet left rail with their own colour, and the readiness banner shares the column-zero receipt gutter so the transcript reads with one consistent left edge

Context pressure now measures the latest actual or estimated packed prompt against a dedicated model context window, defaults every unspecified route to 500k without confusing retrieval or lifetime budgets, and exposes prompt, persisted transcript, tool, epoch, and lifetime ledgers separately

The transcript is now fully reachable after resume and during long responses through row-virtualized PageUp/PageDown, Shift+Up/Down, Home/End, mouse-wheel, and trackpad navigation with stable streaming anchors and safe mouse-sequence suppression in the composer

Each user turn keeps only its four newest bulky tool results model-visible while replacing superseded output with structured evidence receipts, preventing one agentic question from repeatedly resending an unbounded tool transcript

Graphite, Cinder, and Midnight terminal themes now use brighter, more saturated semantic colors with measured hierarchy and contrast guards for common elevated dark backgrounds, while Paper, Mono, NO_COLOR, ASCII, dumb-terminal, and screen-reader behavior stays stable
Fresh-session local-context metadata now preserves visible spacing around its separator, with an exact banner regression guarding the published terminal frame

Interactive sessions now keep a composer-first single-column workspace: permanent Goose art, marketing copy, labelled composer rules, multi-line telemetry, and the wide Team Cockpit are replaced by a quiet one-row identity, one-row footer, and a collapsible active-agent summary with accessible responsive fallbacks

Team Cockpit now promotes queued agents in place when they start, preventing duplicated teammates and React duplicate-key warnings throughout queued, running, retry, and completed lifecycle transitions

Version 0.3.55 introduced a responsive Skein Goose lockup, prior-session cleanup, and bounded reading width; its permanent workspace branding is superseded by the current composer-first identity while the responsive and accessibility guards remain

Configured Claude external-agent routes now pass their exact relay endpoint, credential reference, authentication placement, and safe custom headers to the isolated child, while agents list remains usable as a credential-free inspection command

Named connections now separate provider identity from OpenAI Responses, OpenAI Chat, Anthropic Messages, or Gemini wire protocols, support Bearer, x-api-key, custom-header, command, and explicit no-auth credentials, and keep model-catalog discovery distinct from inference
Shell completion for bash, zsh, and fish is generated from the live Commander graph so new subcommands and options cannot silently drift out of the completion surface

A versioned strong-provider comparison corpus records deterministic capability, orchestration, security, context, and UX scenarios for GPT and Claude relay evaluation without turning model self-report into completion evidence

Markdown files under .agents/commands become workspace slash commands with $ARGUMENTS substitution and unshadowable built-ins, Esc/Ctrl+C cleared drafts return via ArrowUp history, and an idle Ctrl+C now asks for a second press before exiting
The bilingual Fable 5 rewrite is now the deployed website: GitHub Pages serves website-fable-5, the old intro.html URL redirects to the guide, and the rewrite's verification joins npm run check
A ground-up bilingual EN/zh-CN website rewrite ships under website-fable-5/ with pre-paint language selection, enforced string parity, truthful-claims guards, and its own verification script
New /model command shows the active route, lists the named connection's catalog, and switches the model id within the connection without touching endpoint, protocol, or credentials
New /resume command lists recent sessions and swaps the terminal to one by id prefix, clearing session approvals and steering on switch
Approval cards arm for 300ms before accepting y or a so keystrokes buffered while typing cannot grant anything; deny keys stay instant

Root --help documents the print-mode exit-code contract, print-mode --continue/--resume fail clearly when no saved session exists, and the stream-json terminal record now carries the final assistant response text
The introduction page floats the Skein Goose flight mark over the hero and keeps mobile navigation reachable via horizontal scroll
Approvals never apply to hidden text: long or multi-line shell and git commands now render in full, wrapped to the card width with a bounded line count, on both ordinary and live-human approval cards

A tool call that maps to several ask categories now shows one approval card covering all of them; a single y or a settles the call, session grants cover every pending category's exact-target key, and deny policy plus ask-mode still fail per category before any prompt
Pasted code keeps its indentation: tabs become two spaces in the composer instead of being stripped

Write approvals now show a bounded colored diff preview of exactly what would change: write_file diffs proposed content against the current file, apply_patch shows its hunks, ten lines plus a truncation count, with binary and oversized targets degrading to an explanatory line and compact or narrow layouts hiding the preview entirely; the preview is display-only and never persisted

The composer gains a ! shell escape: !<command> runs one command through the same permission, receipt, checkpoint, and changed-file pipeline as model tool calls with a warning-styled shell mode, never spends a model turn, and stays fail-closed under ask denials and deny policy
Fresh sessions now show the indexed file count in the readiness line on wide terminals plus a one-line pointer to the most recent prior session with its age and the skein --continue command
skein status now reports the default connection's real credential state and shows a missing API key as a warning instead of treating compatible providers as configured

A self-contained product introduction page ships at /intro.html with an animated real-output terminal tour, keyboard-accessible tabs, honest capability claims, reduced-motion support, and zero external dependencies

Local-only commands (index, search, context, status, doctor, config show) now work without a complete model connection: an incomplete default connection degrades to legacy model info instead of blocking, while explicit --connection and model-backed chat stay fail-closed with the exact incomplete-credential error

Root help now groups every subcommand under Getting started, Context & retrieval, Sessions & recovery, and Agents & extensions, ends with runnable examples plus Website/Docs/Issues pointers, and a regression fails when a new command lacks a group

Single-word prompts within a small edit distance of a real subcommand emit a non-blocking stderr hint instead of silently spending a model call, with adjacent-transposition matching and short-word substitution safeguards

A guarded POSIX installer wraps global npm install with Node 22.16 prerequisite checks, exact version pinning, dry-run planning, and PATH verification while npm registry checksums continue to enforce package integrity
The idle composer rotates starter hints behind a stable Type a request anchor and stays static under reduced motion, screen readers, and dumb terminals
skein feedback prints the issue tracker URL with a content-free environment summary, and published package metadata now resolves npm repo, bugs, and homepage
Every build regenerates man/skein.1 from the CLI's own help output across all 21 subcommands so the installed manual can never drift from real commands

An opt-in Claude Code writer can now implement one bounded change inside a Skein-owned disposable worktree with safe mode, file-only tools, a pre-request USD cap, hard timeout, cancellation, API review, patch SHA, and live-human integration gates

Claude writer runs combine a stable writable Profile with a dynamic Review Contract brief, while privacy-safe streamed tool names and counts make progress visible in Team Cockpit without exposing arguments, file content, prompts, or reasoning
Read-only external expert recovery can invoke trusted Codex, Claude, or Grok runtimes with bounded profiles, minimal environments, explicit doctor guidance, and no provider-secret inheritance
External expert runs emit bounded heartbeats and preserve timeout truth, so a child process that exits after cancellation cannot turn a partial report into a successful result

A production-ready zero-dependency Skein website adds the Skein Goose identity, interactive terminal story, responsive and accessible product guidance, privacy-first metadata, deterministic verification, and GitHub Pages deployment
The macOS PTY release gate now derives its expected startup version from package metadata, preventing valid patch releases from failing against a stale literal
Fresh interactive sessions now open as a composer-first workspace with one brand signature, one truthful readiness line, and on-demand /status detail instead of a permanent operations dashboard

Successful visual workspace preparation clears its temporary loading frame before chat while screen readers retain linear announcements, and compact permission receipts take priority over stale inspectors

The original Skein Goose identity adds a user-approved woven-flight raster, deterministic light/dark/mono SVG and PNG marks, a one-cell Unicode terminal signature, ASCII fallback, accessible naming, and asset regression gates
Background workers bind child close before awaiting spawn or metadata I/O, preventing short-lived commands from losing their exit event and remaining stuck in running state
Optional user-trusted stdio LSP adapters provide bounded definition, references, and diagnostics without coupling the local index or TUI to an installed language server

Session-owned durable background jobs persist content-free lifecycle state and bounded incremental stdout/stderr across CLI restarts with heartbeat recovery, retention, concurrency, runtime, and disk limits

Every model-initiated background start and kill requires live human approval, start remains completion-unresolved, and one-time HMAC descriptors plus minimal environments prevent command substitution and provider-secret inheritance
Skein jobs start, list, output, and kill provide explicit operator recovery while POSIX cancellation targets process groups and disabling future starts does not hide or strand existing jobs
Explicit executable paths now receive the same workspace exclusion checks as PATH discovery, closing a trust-boundary gap for editors, Git helpers, agent runtimes, and language servers
Session fork and branch commands create SHA-256-bound logical continuations with fresh usage accounting, while explicit --branch/--worktree/--yes can place a fork in an isolated sibling Git worktree
Alt+E and /editor round-trip bounded owner-only drafts through VISUAL or EDITOR without a shell, workspace executable resolution, or provider and relay secrets
Bash, zsh, and fish completion scripts expose Skein commands, session branching, and common global options without adding a runtime dependency
Explicit OpenAI Responses routes can use relay-hosted web_search without local network or shell authority, while content-safe call receipts and citation identities bind exact source URLs by SHA-256

User-configured relay pricing produces protocol-aware priced or visibly unpriced cost receipts, and explicit strict USD ceilings fail closed before unpriced requests or stop subsequent work after a measured overrun

Team Run v4 provenance bundles bind route identities, reports, usage, cost, hosted search, sources, peer handoffs, reviewer evidence, writer state, and human arbitration without retaining hidden reasoning
Agents setup, connection inspection, JSON, text, Team Cockpit, and Team Workbench expose hosted capabilities, pricing source, cost, and source counts across responsive and accessible terminal modes
Subprocess-heavy capability CLI regression coverage now has a CI-sized timeout budget, preventing healthy Linux release verification from failing during repeated cold tsx startup
Memory privacy review reports content-free scope, lifecycle, provenance-risk, and owner-only storage aggregates while explicitly disclosing that SQLite is not encrypted at rest

Memory export selects user, workspace, or all records and candidates, writes owner-only JSON atomically, and rejects destination symlinks; permanent clear requires explicit headless confirmation and attempts secure SQLite compaction
Workspace Skills now fail closed until the exact workspace, source path, and SKILL.md fingerprint is trusted; content drift and explicit revocation block activation across runtime, CLI, and TUI
Skill and workflow surfaces disclose source, trust, activation effect, content fingerprint, read-only catalog access, and single-writer execution semantics
Capability Registry v2 migrates v1 on read and records labelled model, endpoint, auth, prompt, tool-catalog, and generation-policy component epochs under a stable logical route identity

Receipt-backed failures move an exact task/route epoch through healthy, degraded, and quarantined states; quarantined routes leave shadow recommendations until two distinct deterministic canaries pass
Agents capability canary ingests only bounded integrity-valid capability_canary receipt files and never runs a probe, contacts a provider, or accepts ordinary tool receipts or model self-report
Verified capability outcomes can bind request-level Token Ledger entries, derive actual and estimated totals, reject mismatched caller metrics, and persist only bounded aggregates plus content hashes

Agents capability replay evaluates strict content-free route regret, strong/medium tier and provider-hash coverage, Token Ledger links, judge position/verbosity/self-preference stability, and degradation/recovery fixtures
Local replay bundles cannot attest external validation or enable automatic selection; capability mode remains limited to off and shadow, and quarantines never retarget a live run

Team Run v4 adds blind Reviewer inputs, stable round-based candidate ordering, bounded report lengths, Author/Reviewer independence evidence, model-provider/family correlation, criterion conflicts, and artifact-bound human arbitration while retaining v1/v2/v3 read compatibility

Deterministic oracle results remain authoritative: failures cannot be overridden, passing receipts take precedence over conflicting model judgment, and conflicts remain content-free calibration evidence
Unknown criteria, unresolved conflicts, and insufficient high-risk Reviewer independence produce needs_review across CLI, TUI, JSON, and JSONL; headless runs stop with exit code 9
Agents arbitrate records one live-interactive human decision for an open required criterion and rejects stale, duplicate, optional, unknown, non-interactive, or deterministically failing decisions

Git push, npm publish, deployments, migrations, destructive commands, external mutations, and writer integration require live-human approval that model review, --yes, config allow, or ordinary session grants cannot replace

Relay inference and model-directory authentication are independent: bearer and x-api-key remain supported, while modelsAuthHeader none guarantees public catalog discovery does not read or send the inference credential

First-run onboarding and agents setup expose separate inference and model-catalog authentication without protocol or header probing, preserving omitted-field compatibility and preventing cross-protocol retry billing
Capability Registry v1 stores only workspace-bound SHA-256 identities, bounded route epochs and aggregates, recent evidence hashes, and fingerprint-bound pins in an owner-only atomic project file

Shadow capability reports keep user-configured priors separate from receipt-backed observed intervals, apply Wilson lower bounds plus bounded token, latency, and tool-failure penalties, and never change live model selection
Route epochs bind runtime, connection, provider, protocol, model, endpoint/auth reference, profile prompt, tool catalog, generation settings, and budgets; stale pins fail closed after drift
Agents capability inspect, pin, unpin, export, and reset expose content-free local routing evidence while off mode remains read-only and untrusted project config cannot inject priors
Team Run review replaces text-prefix reviewer acceptance with a strict ReviewVerdict bound to the semantic Task Contract, exact artifact SHA-256, reviewer route, and content-addressed verdict body

Every required criterion must cite a supplied evidence handle; missing, duplicate, unknown, fenced, prose-wrapped, or malformed reviewer output fails closed, while deterministic failures can never be overridden by model acceptance
Every executed, rejected, skipped, or failed tool result now receives a canonical content-addressed receipt without retaining command arguments, output, source, or credential text
Council report bundles are persisted as verified content-addressed artifacts per review round, and writer patches run HEAD, clean-target, path, and git-apply preflight before spending a Reviewer call
Legacy Team Run v1/v2 manifests remain inspectable but v2 text reviews cannot authorize writer integration; Task Contract or artifact changes invalidate prior verdicts
Agents show, stream JSON, and the Team Workbench expose accept, revise, escalate, pass, fail, and unknown state without duplicating raw reviewer JSON in terminal text

Named primary connections now target third-party compatible relays only, use explicit env or none authentication, and resolve one complete profile automatically while requiring an explicit choice for ambiguity
OpenAI Responses is the recommended new transport with POST /responses, store false, typed SSE, normalized tools and usage, and bounded exact output-item replay for stateless reasoning continuation

OpenAI Chat Completions and Anthropic Messages remain explicit relay transports without cross-protocol retries; inference and OpenAI-style model catalog base URLs and authentication are configured independently
Relay model discovery now uses a bounded 15-minute ETag cache isolated by endpoint and credential fingerprints, invalidates authentication failures, and never stores or echoes credential values

First-run and agents setup flows are relay-only, save only credential environment-variable names, and expose redacted connection state consistently across TUI, text, JSON, JSONL, doctor, and config output
Provider diagnostics redact secrets, authorization headers, URL credentials, and query strings while Responses replay state is capped at 128 items and 4 MiB in memory and persisted sessions
External delegated CLIs now receive a minimal runtime-owned environment instead of inheriting provider, Skein, relay, or NODE_OPTIONS secrets
TERM=dumb and screen-reader sessions now use deterministic ASCII, monochrome, reduced-motion, non-incremental rendering without losing keyboard input
SKEIN_SCREEN_READER=1 enables Ink accessibility output with semantic timeline, permission, and composer roles plus clean phase boundaries
PTY release gates now replay eight terminal scenarios through a headless emulator and reject final-frame overflow, stale panels, announcement joins, and missing status
A local terminal UI benchmark enforces 25 ms input and 150 ms streaming-render p95 budgets while retaining the final streamed chunk
MCP trust and revoke confirmation rendering now has a deterministic cross-platform release regression gate
MCP now follows a no-network search and inspect review before explicit workspace-bound manifest trust and lazy activation
Declarative capability manifests expose redacted source, version, tools, permissions, network, command, path, sensitive-field, process, and completion-evidence effects
Persistent disable and revoke unload active remote schemas while manifest fingerprint changes fail closed to untrusted
Server annotations cannot lower local permissions, named manifests reject injected undeclared schemas, and optional server failures remain isolated
Only explicitly required trusted MCP servers may block startup, while status inspection no longer connects optional servers
Sensitive MCP arguments are redacted from terminal, TUI, JSON, and approval events; unsupported external mutations remain completion-unresolved
Explain and review intents expose smaller built-in schema sets, and MCP activation reports deterministic eager-versus-loaded schema estimates plus top-match evidence
First-run setup now states that the primary agent needs API credentials and that provider subscriptions or signed-in coding CLIs are separate delegated tools
Permission prompts show the policy reason, redacted target, working directory, category risk, and explicit once, session, deny, and stop choices
The Recovery Center joins last-run state, failure repair hints, changed files, checkpoints, diff, audit, rollback, retry, and safe session resume
Read-only review commands pin working-tree, commit, or branch scope and inject a content-free redacted evidence bundle without storing it in the user transcript
JSON and JSONL terminal records now follow the published headless v1 schema with stable completed, verification, input, blocked, cancellation, turn, token, and error exit codes
Short terminal viewports clip long lists without overflow and pending clarifications cannot be consumed by recovery commands
Durable sessions now separate a 500k-token context epoch from a 1m-token lifetime ceiling without changing the session id or deleting transcript history
Content-free epoch handoffs preserve Task Contract criteria, unresolved failure circuits, changed files, and verification receipts across long runs
Intent Sufficiency routes clear requests to execution, repository-inferable gaps to inspection, and genuine product choices to one persisted clarification
TUI and headless output expose epoch, lifetime, and needs-input state; queued follow-ups pause and resume after keyboard clarification instead of becoming accidental answers
Successful identical tool calls clear matching historical failure signatures from later epoch handoffs
Context compaction now rebuilds authoritative task, working-state, verification, permission, failure, and artifact facts outside generated narrative
Automatic compaction runs only when three predicted prompt reuses produce positive net token savings while explicit compact commands remain available
Compaction provider usage is included in session totals with separate content-free actual or estimated receipts
Empty or lossy narratives cannot erase deterministic facts, and the complete persisted transcript remains unchanged
Normal chat startup now exposes a compact mcp_activate catalog instead of eagerly connecting MCP servers
MCP activation connects one selected server, discovers remote tools, and loads at most eight relevant schemas
Explicit MCP diagnostics can still connect eagerly while all MCP activation and remote calls remain network operations
OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini usage now normalizes cached input, cache-write input, and reasoning tokens when reported
Token Ledger, session totals, and structured usage events preserve provider cache and reasoning counts without prompt content
Streaming, non-streaming, explicit-zero, and legacy-session compatibility paths are covered without claiming cache activation
Failed configured verification output yields bounded current-run diagnostic ranking without persisting paths
Diagnostic hints cannot create zero-relevance hits and are cleared on success or the next agent run
Python absolute and relative module imports now contribute deterministic offline graph adjacency
Context provenance exposes the diagnostic score alongside graph and isolated Git recency signals
Local index v3 records TypeScript AST definitions, calls, and relative import adjacency for graph-assisted retrieval
Context hits expose generation, content hash, matched terms, and bm25/path/symbol/phrase/graph score provenance
Context benchmark v2 locks multilingual recall, MRR, useful-token, stale-hit, incremental-index, and warm-latency gates
Large MCP catalogs now disclose at most eight request-relevant schemas per run while preserving network permissions
Token Ledger receipts report deferred progressive schemas and selected definitions remain stable across tool turns
A deterministic Token Economy replay benchmark guards evidence, output-firewall, and no-progress invariants
Calibrated Type-1/2 duplication matches now block completion until reuse or exact audited suppression
Type-3 duplication remains warning-only and Type-4 semantic equivalence remains explicitly unsupported
Duplication benchmark fixtures report deterministic recall, precision, false-positive rate, and latency
Duplication warnings now aggregate into the single completion receipt without changing verified status
Exact match ids support bounded, reason-coded suppression with audit and credential/code-block safeguards
Duplication audit tools are disclosed only when active warnings exist and repaired paths clear stale matches
Warning-only TS/JS duplication audit compares new functions with the pre-write index generation
Deterministic Type-1/2 and Type-3 receipts retain only hashes, locations, scores, and bounded counts
Ordinary edits, renames, moves, deletions, small functions, tests, generated paths, and failed writes stay quiet
Warning-only Reuse Gate records content-free candidate evidence before the first substantive write
Reuse receipts surface unresolved index/read failures instead of claiming a safe new implementation
Prompt and timeline diagnostics expose the repository-first reuse ladder without blocking legitimate writes
Known tool changes refresh only their affected local-index paths before the next model turn
File ctime closes same-size and restored-mtime zero-hit freshness gaps without full-content scans
Repeated empty or unchanged search calls stop through the existing recovery circuit
Git recency is an isolated, bounded tie-break with exact HEAD-bound cache invalidation and non-Git degradation

scripts.release:verify: npm run check && npm run verify:package --
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run website:check && npm run website:fable5:check && npm run build && npm run smoke:dist
